newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat up on KCBT spillover, harvest delays.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat up on KCBT spillover, harvest delays.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures rallied in fast trade Monday on spillover strength from KCBT wheat and talk of harvest delays in hard red winter wheat areas, traders said.
At 0949 CDT KCBT wheat futures were one to 7-1/2 cents per bushel higher on harvest delays in Texas and Oklahoma, floor traders said.
Concerns about the potential for disease in the soft red winter wheat crop were also seen supporting prices, traders said.
LIT, Merrill Lynch, Rosenthal Collins and Shatkin, Arbor and Karlov were all noted buyers in July wheat, traders said.
At 0954 CDT, CBOT July wheat was six cents per bushel higher at $3.65-1/2, and other months were two to 6-1/4 higher.
